brief:
A international law professor told Shehab Wire that the death of nine-month-old infant Kinan Ahmad Arquiq from acute hypothermia demonstrates Israel's violations of its obligations under humanitarian law. Muhammad Mahmoud Mehran said the occupation authorities bear responsibility for providing relief and shelter to Gaza's population under the Geneva Conventions and customary international law.

Mehran outlined legal pathways to enforce these obligations, according to the wire service. The expert indicated that documented deaths from exposure establish grounds for accountability through international courts and mechanisms designed to protect civilians in conflict zones.

title: Legal expert outlines mechanisms to compel Israeli occupation to aid Gaza
